verdict.rationale: Asking whether user-submitted data may be used for AI training is a fair privacy question for any service that holds filer data, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that the edge (Akamai, then Incapsula) blocks automated agents at robots.txt and the filing portal. That is an adjacent anti-crawler control, not a documented user-facing guarantee or opt-out against AI training on the user's data. No policy, setting, or statement on AI training use appears in the evidence.
